name: vale
description: Set up Vale, fix its alerts, triage a first run, and keep prose linted as you edit.

level.title: Alert level the edit hook reports
level.description: Lowest severity handed back to Claude after it edits a prose file: "error", "warning", or "suggestion". Errors only by default, because warnings and suggestions are advisory by the project's own choice. Widen it for a style whose rules are deliberately advisory. An unrecognised value is treated as "error".
